baseline_models.focus_anchor: The question يَنظُرُوا ... كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَاهَا directs attention to the sky above, its adornment, and its lack of فُرُوج.
baseline_models.mechanism: Sight or reflection is directed at an overhead object whose parts have been joined into a finished structure. Adornment makes the workmanship visible, while the negated fissures make continuity rather than mere size the diagnostic feature.

activation_trace.role: Directing sight or insight toward a thing supplies the deliberate inspecting operation rather than a passing glance.
What rises and shades supplies the overhead object or roof that inspection addresses.
Spatial elevation fixes the inspected structure directly above the audience.
Joining parts into a building supplies the construction mechanism whose manner is queried.
Making beauty visible supplies a finish integrated into the crafted surface.
An opening or fissure between things supplies the defect explicitly negated and thus the structure's continuity.

changed_reading.before: A general invitation to notice that the sky is beautiful.
changed_reading.after: An invitation to inspect how an overhead structure is assembled, visibly finished, and continuous without a failed joint.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence يَنظُرُوا ... السَّمَاءِ ... زَيَّنَّاهَا makes seeing, the sky, and visible enhancement mutually active.
baseline_models.mechanism: The non-dominant و س م mapping in the sky inventory activates a surface-sign model: an observer infers a condition from a visible mark. Adornment and gaplessness can therefore function as legible evidence of the sky's made condition, not decoration added after the proof.

activation_trace.role: Sight joined to reflection supplies the readerly act by which visible features become evidence.
A sign from which an observer infers a condition supplies the exploratory idea of the sky as a marked, readable surface.
Displayed enhancement supplies the positive visual marks that carry the inference.
The absent fissure supplies a negative but still visible mark of coherent workmanship.

changed_reading.before: The sky's adornment is ornamental beauty alongside a separate claim of sound construction.
changed_reading.after: Adornment and gaplessness are readable marks through which the observer infers the sky's crafted condition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The built sky is followed directly by وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٍ, an unrestricted negation of openings.
baseline_models.mechanism: The form-distant س م م target in the sky inventory pairs a narrow aperture with sealing and tightening. Because the focus itself negates fissures after building, these branches activate a deliberately non-porous enclosure rather than only a structure that happens not to be cracked.

activation_trace.role: A narrow aperture supplies the porosity that the focus's unrestricted negation excludes.
Sealing and tightening supply an exploratory closure operation for the overhead enclosure.
Joining components into a building anchors the seal image in an explicit act of construction.
The literal opening or gap is what the constructed enclosure is said not to possess.

changed_reading.before: The sky is defect-free because no cracks are observable.
changed_reading.after: The sky is exploratorily pictured as an intentionally sealed enclosure whose non-porosity is part of its construction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The confused, intermixed affair immediately before the focus is answered by a visible counter-form: joined construction, ordered adornment, and no fissure. The contrast relocates disorder from the inspected creation to the observers' apprehension of it.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate visual or reflective inspection supplies the operation that can correct confused apprehension.
Parts joined into a building supply the ordered counter-form.
The negated fissure makes the counter-form continuous rather than internally disjointed.
Mixture and disorder in an affair supply the epistemic condition against which the sky's integration is read.

structural_cues: 50:5 ends with an affair described as confused immediately before 50:6 asks whether they inspect a built, adorned, fissureless sky.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent confusion and integrated construction; I infer a contrast locating disorder in their apprehension rather than in the inspected object. A live alternative is that 50:6 simply begins a separate proof.

changed_reading.before: The sky is an independent example of flawless workmanship.
changed_reading.after: The sky's joined and gapless form is a diagnostic correction to the observers' preceding state of conceptual mixture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The overhead construction becomes the upper member of a coordinated vertical system: the earth is extended and stabilized below, water descends, dead land lives, and emergence follows. Structural integrity in 50:6 thus supports a working life-and-return order rather than a static ceiling.

activation_trace.role: The elevated thing that shades supplies the system's upper environmental member.
Spatial above-ness establishes the vertical relation to the earth described next.
Joined construction supplies a stable upper component rather than an inert visual backdrop.
Absence of structural gaps supplies maintained integrity within the larger system.
Drawing something out continuously supplies the earth's extended lower field beneath the sky.
Firm fixation supplies stability to the lower field paired with the intact upper structure.
Downward arrival supplies the dynamic link from the sky to the earth.
Earth coming alive through rain and growth supplies the system's life-producing result.
Passing from inside to outside converts revived growth into an explicit model of emergence.

structural_cues: 50:6-11 moves from the sky above, to extended and anchored earth, to water descending from the sky, to revived dead land, and finally to emergence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the vertical sequence and its life result; I infer that the intact sky is a working upper component and that this cycle previews resurrection. A live alternative is that these are parallel signs without a single causal-system emphasis.

changed_reading.before: The gapless sky is a stable and beautiful ceiling considered by itself.
changed_reading.after: The gapless sky is the stable upper component of a sky-earth system whose downward provision produces life and models emergence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The question how the sky was built becomes evidence about capacity: first creation did not defeat its maker, renewed creation is the disputed novelty, and creation of heavens and earth incurred no fatigue. The completed, unfailed structure is therefore an argument from demonstrated capacity to re-creation.

activation_trace.role: Joining the sky into a built whole supplies the already accomplished work from which capacity is inferred.
The absence of a failed opening supplies visible completion rather than exhausted or defective work.
Inability to find the way through a task supplies the incapacity explicitly denied of first creation.
Bringing creation into existence supplies both the completed first act and the contested renewed act.
New occurrence after a break supplies the specific renewal whose possibility is disputed.
Weakness and fatigue supply the cost explicitly negated after creating the heavens and earth.

structural_cues: 50:15 contrasts first creation with new creation, while 50:38 returns to creation of the heavens and earth and negates fatigue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies completed first creation, disputed renewal, and no fatigue; I infer that the visible integrity in 50:6 functions as demonstrated capacity for another act. A live alternative is that it proves workmanship without specifically encoding re-creation.

changed_reading.after: The completed and unfailed sky is a visible warrant that creation was neither baffling nor exhausting, so renewed creation is within demonstrated capacity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Present inspection is an offered mode of disclosure: the crafted sky bears marks readable by eye and insight. Later, heedlessness ends when a covering is lifted and sight becomes penetrating, so 50:6 offers voluntary recognition before compelled eschatological visibility.

activation_trace.role: Directed sight or insight supplies the present opportunity for voluntary recognition.
A visible sign from which condition is inferred supplies the exploratory legibility of the sky.
Displayed beauty supplies the positive marks available to present sight.
Insight of the heart makes the preceding cosmic sequence an inward disclosure as well as an ocular scene.
Inattention that leaves a thing outside awareness supplies the failed present response to available signs.
Lifting a cover supplies the later transition from optional attention to unavoidable disclosure.
A concealing cover supplies the obstruction removed from perception.
Ocular seeing supplies the now-unavoidable future perception.
A sharp, penetrating edge supplies the intensified quality of future sight.

structural_cues: 50:8 labels the preceding cosmic sequence an insight and reminder; 50:22 later removes a covering and makes sight sharp.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a present invitation to look and a later scene of forced unveiling; I infer a temporal contrast between voluntary reading now and compelled sight then. A live alternative is that the later sight scene is eschatological without revising the earlier invitation.

changed_reading.before: Look now because the sky is available to ordinary observation.
changed_reading.after: Read the available marks now, before covering-removal turns neglected disclosure into inescapably sharp sight.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sky's present lack of fissures and the earth's future rapid splitting are phase-specific functions, not rival standards of perfection. Maintained closure displays present integrity; later opening releases people for gathering with ease.

activation_trace.role: Joined construction supplies the maintained integrity of the present structure.
The opening explicitly absent from the sky supplies the initial closed state.
Movement from inside to outside supplies the later opening's purpose: emergence.
Splitting and opening supply the deliberate future reversal of the focus's no-opening image.
The opposite of slowness makes the transition from enclosure to emergence immediate.
Driving and collecting a group toward one destination supplies the opening's social function.
Opening into ease after difficulty supplies the effortless execution of the future split and gathering.

structural_cues: 50:42 names the day of emergence; 50:44 then depicts the earth splitting from people rapidly and calls the gathering easy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies present sky-closure and future earth-opening for emergence; I infer that integrity and opening are complementary timed functions under one agency. A live alternative is that the sky-earth contrast is rhetorical without a shared engineering model.

changed_reading.before: Perfect creation is characterized by never having an opening.
changed_reading.after: The sky's no-opening state is present-purpose integrity, while another created structure can open exactly on time for emergence and gathering.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps a material fissure to informational omission. It remains anchored in the focus's built, gapless whole and is activated by the surah's sequence of bodily loss, preserved writing, emitted speech, and guarding; downstream prose should present it only as a cross-domain analogy, not as a lexical claim that فُرُوج means missing records.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: بَنَيْنَاهَا and وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٍ supply an assembled whole from which no gap is visible.

activation_trace.role: Joining parts into a whole supplies the material source domain for a complete record.
The absent gap supplies the cross-domain image of no omitted interval.
Loss of part of a thing supplies the threatened subtraction that the record must answer.
Ordered letters and the written object supply the record medium.
Guarding and preserving supply the record's resistance to loss.
Speech emitted by the tongue supplies the fleeting material that nevertheless enters accountability.
Guarding and surveillance supply the mechanism that closes a possible recording gap.

changed_reading.before: No fissures describes only the sky's material integrity.
changed_reading.after: The gapless built whole can also serve, cautiously, as a visible material analogue for a record from which bodily loss and uttered acts do not disappear.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because watchman, frontier, and seal branches recast cosmological description as security or jurisdiction. It remains anchored in ن ظ ر, the split sky inventory, and ف ر ج, then gains context from a watcher, traversed lands, and failed escape; downstream prose should qualify it as a moral-jurisdiction metaphor, not a claim that the sky is literally a prison or fortress.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus combines looking, an overhead built enclosure, and the denial of any open frontier or breach.

activation_trace.role: A watcher who looks and guards supplies the security posture latent in the call to inspect.
Sealing and tightening supply the exploratory image of a closed jurisdiction overhead.
An open frontier that is a place of danger supplies the breach explicitly absent from the enclosure.
Guarding and surveillance supply the accountability function within the enclosure.
Travel and searching through lands supply an attempted route-finding movement across the jurisdiction.
Turning aside from a direction supplies the escape route that the question leaves unavailable.

changed_reading.before: No fissures means that the sky has no physical cracks.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the sealed overhead whole has no unguarded frontier through which an accountable agent can evade the surah's encompassing jurisdiction.

strongest_changes: The immediately preceding confused affair turns gapless building into a correction of confused perception.
The extended earth, descending water, revived land, and emergence turn the sky from a static roof into the upper component of a life-and-return system.
First versus renewed creation and the later denial of fatigue turn the completed sky into evidence of demonstrated creative capacity.
Later forced unveiling and purposeful earth-splitting make present looking and present closure timed states rather than the final form of perception or structure.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet preserved two productive reversals that a local reading could miss: voluntary inspection becomes compelled sharp sight, and a sky with no openings coexists with an earth that opens exactly for emergence. Split-root inventories also kept live the form-distant models of the sky as a marked surface and a sealed enclosure.
remaining_uncertainties: The و س م and س م م activations are explicitly exploratory because they come from non-dominant split mappings of the sky root.
Treating the sky-earth-water sequence as one working system and the gapless sky as an analogue of a complete record requires reader-supplied cross-verse arrows.
The final opening belongs to the earth rather than the sky, so phase-specific integrity is an inferred structural analogy rather than a direct reversal of the same object.
